about: Fathammer's X-Forge. Triangles are caught where the engine's flush loop calls one of its per-mode fillers (a table of functions chosen by texture, blend and shading), with texture coordinates, colours and the texture (RGB565). Images: two versions of the engine (core with the filler tables from 0x80, or from 0x68 with other offsets).

hooks.note: The engine's present (back buffer to screen), called from its tick with the core in r5: the game has drawn the whole frame, 3D and 2D. No end hook, so skipped triangles are keyed as their fillers return, under the 2D drawn after them. target: the render target the fillers lock.
